description: Being paid on time, in full, without asking. Competence exercised at the edge of capability, with a result that exists afterwards.
energy_note: Something that was not there this morning.

aspect: It is where flow actually happens
description: More reported flow occurs during work than during leisure, which surprises people and holds up. Clear goals, immediate feedback and a matched challenge are ordinary properties of a job and rare properties of an evening.
energy_note: Absorbed at work, passive at home, reliably.

description: Asked years later what made the job good, people name the company rather than the content. The Harvard Study of Adult Development has been producing that result for eighty-seven years.
notes: Harvard Study of Adult Development: relationship quality is the strongest single predictor of health and happiness.

description: An employer, a permit, a licence, a bank that will receive the payment, a registration, and a market. Every one of those is a party that can decline.
energy_note: Several institutions, all of which can say no.
notes: Pairs with WRK and FIN categories across the hurdle datasets - permits, brokers, wage theft, and payment rails that exclude by nationality.

description: Being paid on time, in full, without asking stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.
energy_note: It turns into the story about it.
notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
